```
I0314 20:18:33.796]   [FAILED] Expected
I0314 20:18:33.796]       <string>: "...  3m22s   v..."
I0314 20:18:33.796]   to equal               |
I0314 20:18:33.796]       <string>: "...  3m23s   v..."

```

As Sergey correctly points out is the Age
```
kubectl get nodes multi-worker --subresource=status
NAME           STATUS   ROLES    AGE     VERSION
multi-worker   Ready    <none>   6h42m   v1.27.0-alpha.3.585+6c0f88aea74dfc-dirty
```

```
kubectl get nodes multi-worker --subresource=status
NAME           STATUS   ROLES    AGE     VERSION
multi-worker   Ready    <none>   6h42m   v1.27.0-alpha.3.585+6c0f88aea74dfc-dirty
```

The test can not assume the executions will be done in the same second
